Articos

hey @adana super simple to get going. If you want to try a messaging test:

1. Pick a use case from step 1
2. Add your messaging variants (you can add multiple)
3. Select roles based on your ideal ICP, we'll build the synthetic users for you
4. Review the interview script (you can edit it if needed)
5. Get a report showing the winning variant with reasoning behind it
